S01.camera: push-in 1.0x -> 1.38x from the whole orbiter toward the smoke (eased)
S01.animation: orange ring draws around the smoke at 0.5 s; leader line and boxed label at 0.95 s
S01.typography: headline 'Already leaking' 96 px + 'CHALLENGER · JAN 28, 1986' 30 px; clock T+0.678 s; chip NASA PHOTO
S01.sound: low impact on frame 0; marker tick at 0.5 s; drone fades in
S01.fallback: if the photo is unavailable: GPN-2000-001347 is mirrored by NASA Image and Video Library; never substitute a different launch

S02.camera: stack drawn whole, then 2.1x zoom onto the right booster's lowest field joint
S02.animation: joint band pulses; ring draws; callouts RIGHT BOOSTER / LOWEST JOINT

S03.animation: highlighter sweeps over 'Primary O-Ring' then 'Secondary O-Ring' labels
S03.typography: source line under the figure; chip COMMISSION RECORD

S04.camera: push 1.04 -> 1.16 with a slow tilt down the icicles
S04.typography: 36°F 220 px (cold blue) + one-line context 38 px; chip NASA PHOTO · LAUNCH MORNING

S05.animation: press lifts; warm ring recovers in 0.35 s, cold ring recovers slowly (exponential, still deformed at cut)
S05.typography: WARM / COLD 46 px; 'springs back' / 'stays deformed' 34 px; 'illustration' note

S06.camera: locked, diagram enlarged 1.45x around the joint
S06.animation: pressure arrows at 'ignition'; tang moves away (gap exaggerated); cold O-rings barely follow; hot-gas particles flow past both seals from 'hot'; soot puffs exit outside
S06.typography: PRIMARY / SECONDARY O-RING, GAP callouts 46 px; INSIDE / OUTSIDE; 'HOT GAS BLOWS PAST BOTH SEALS'; chip ANIMATION · NOT TO SCALE
S06.sound: low thump at 'ignition'; band-passed hiss under the blow-by
S06.fallback: Rogers Fig. 14 with drawn gas arrow

S07.camera: archival film, documentary panel 1000x1000 (crop inside the film's letterbox)
S07.animation: mission clock accelerates T+2.7 -> T+58 s

S08.animation: ring on the flame at the joint (measured position), callout FLAME AT THE JOINT; clock T+58.788 s running
S08.typography: clock; chip NASA TRACKING FILM E-207
S08.fallback: Challenger Rocket Booster still GPN-2000-001422 is NOT a substitute (it shows breakup); use S09 only

S09.camera: stack framed on the lower right booster and tank, 1.3x -> 1.5x
S09.animation: plume grows from the joint and swings onto the External Tank; glow on the tank; orbiter ghosted; clock 60.2 -> 64.66, then 73 s; frame darkens - no explosion is drawn
S09.typography: FLAME REACHES THE TANK, then THE TANK FAILS; chip RECONSTRUCTION
S09.sound: drone at its highest level, then cut to silence
S09.fallback: text card with the Commission timeline

S10.camera: 1.0 -> 1.04, held once, no slow motion, no replay
S10.typography: chip NASA PHOTO · ABOUT 76 s AFTER LAUNCH
S10.fallback: omit the image and hold black with the line

S11.camera: whole portrait, 1.0 -> 1.05 centred push; nobody cropped out
S11.typography: 'THE STS-51-L CREW' 28 px; chip NASA PORTRAIT · 1985
S11.fallback: none - do not substitute other crew imagery

S12.animation: quote types on; 53°F and 36°F lines draw at 'fifty-three'
S12.typography: Source Serif 56 px quote; attribution 24 px; chart labels 32 px; chip COMMISSION RECORD · TYPESET

S13.animation: node 1, link with 'at NASA Marshall's urging' at 'reversed', broken dashed link with red X and node 3 at 'never'
S13.typography: 44 px node titles, 32 px subtitles; source line; chip EXPLANATORY DIAGRAM
S13.sound: mechanical clunk in; low note at the broken link

S14.typography: 'The seal failed in the cold.' 96 px; NASA caption line; chip NASA PHOTO · RECOVERED

S15.camera: pull back 1.42x -> 1.0x to the opening framing (loops into frame 0)
S15.typography: dimmed first line 64 px + 'But the warning failed the night before.' 76 px amber
S15.sound: low payoff note, pad resolves and fades
S15.transition: cut on 'But' (a crossfade overlapped the two headlines in QA)
